name: Chisa Gode
source:
Chisa Gode is the daughter of Gazel Gode, the Mayor of the town of Kathtom from the Free Cities Alliance. Due to her father's fragile health, by the start the events of Rance 02 she had been managing much of the administrative affairs of the town.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Cith_Gode]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
